Category ratings: Job Security 3.9, Work-Life Balance 3.7, Company Culture 3.6, Skill Development 3.5, Work Satisfaction 3.3, Salary 2.7, Promotions 2.6. Work-policy module: Hybrid reported by 85%, 5 days/week by 88%, flexible timing by 73%, no travel by 66%. AI summary PROS: work-life balance and hybrid flexibility with wellness programs; learning opportunities via LEX and global projects (357-370 review mentions); job security / bench retention (180 mentions). CONS: low pay vs market and weak appraisals (1.1k mentions), slow or opaque promotions (601), inconsistent managers and project allocation, repetitive or support-focused assignments depending on project (mixed job-satisfaction theme).
